item.title: Alleged Charlie Kirk assassin Tyler Robinson's fingerprints, palm print found near rooftop: report
item.summary: Newly released search warrants reportedly reveal DNA and phone evidence in the case against Tyler Robinson, accused of assassinating Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Bessent, Powell summon Wall Street CEOs for emergency meeting over Anthropic AI risks amid Pentagon dispute
item.summary: Treasury's Bessent and Fed's Powell reportedly called a flash meeting with Wall Street bank heads to warn of cybersecurity risks from Anthropic's AI.

item.title: Teens suspected of murdering congressional intern linked by DNA on shell casings, prosecutors say
item.summary: DNA evidence allegedly links two teenagers to the fatal shooting of a University of Massachusetts student working as a congressional intern in D.C.

item.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's home targeted in Molotov cocktail attack; man arrested: police
item.summary: A person is in custody in San Francisco, California, Friday for allegedly throwing a Molotov cocktail at the home of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

item.title: McDonald's CEO dragged again after another awkward food video: 'Nugget bite was worse'
item.summary: Chris Kempczinski, CEO of the fast-food chain McDonald's, sparked fresh backlash after a new interview attempting to address his viral Big Arch burger review.

item.title: Bryson DeChambeau not pleased with 3D-printed club question after eventful day at Augusta National
item.summary: Bryson DeChambeau struggled in the first round of the Masters with a 4-over 76, then gave a blunt response when asked about his custom 3D-printed 5-iron.

item.title: Marriage status has surprising link to cancer risk, study suggests: 'Clear signal'
item.summary: Never-married adults are significantly more likely to develop cancer, according to a University of Miami study of over 4 million people in 12 states.

item.title: Michelle Obama says America going through its 'janky' era
item.summary: Michelle Obama told comedian Hasan Minhaj on her podcast that America is in a "janky" era, and said it was necessary for the country's growth.

item.title: Realtor's cold case murder suspect accused of fleeing scene, skipping 911 call in new witness account: report
item.summary: Newly released court documents reveal a witness reportedly saw suspect Kristin Ramsey flee erratically after the 2011 shooting of Ashley Okland in Iowa.

item.title: Jaguars plan to change Travis Hunter's usage after injury-shortened rookie season: report
item.summary: Travis Hunter, the former Heisman Trophy winner, will reportedly shift to full-time cornerback duties with the Jacksonville Jaguars after playing mostly offense in 2025.
